name: Generic Web Research & Intelligence Synthesis
description: Multi-machine research playbook that searches target companies, products, or founders across web browsers, extracts structured insights, and generates an Obsidian report.

workflow.description: Fleet Orchestrator initializes Web Research campaign.
Research Agent scans target web sites and extracts key metrics & intelligence.
Obsidian Agent writes structured Markdown summary to Obsidian Vault.
Fleet Orchestrator sends summary notification to Discord/Telegram channel.
